title: UCaaS <-> Switch: trunk auth / tenant identification
description: Mirror of redfire-switch IpAuthConfig for the UCaaS platform interconnect. The UCaaS platform egresses from source_networks; each tenant is identified by a tech_prefix that resolves to a switch customer_id (== boss voice_accounts.switchAccountId). Keep this in sync with redfire-switch authentication.rs IpAuthConfig.

tech_prefix.description: Per-tenant account key; matches techprefix contract

gpu_transcode_at_carrier.description: Opt-in per-trunk flag. When true, the switch advertises GPU Opus<->G.711 transcode for WebRTC-to-PSTN calls, so the UCaaS side offers Opus toward the switch instead of transcoding in FreeSWITCH. Requires real Opus support on the switch (currently a stub); the UCaaS side must fall back to FreeSWITCH transcode when false or when the GPU pool is saturated.
